description: No FR-048/CT-33 Bot-mint gate exists on the qmf.registry public surface: there is no both-QL-8-conformance-layers mint path (mint only when both pass, else policy rejection). CT-33 is wiring_status defined-unwired; QML authors the Bot declaration and the composition root mints it under AD-25, so the ratified surface is unrealized in this package rather than defective. Recorded as a coverage gap per the PLAN untestable-note #2, not a code defect.

observed: qmf.registry exposes no bot/conformance/strategy_family/footprint symbol; RESERVED_KIND_NAMES has no bot-definition; the gate cannot be exercised even with injected verdicts.
